notes: Roadmap MVP §34, scores out of 100. The a11y / best-practices / seo thresholds were raised after AA contrasts, immutable cache for hashed assets and latin-only fonts. Median of LH_RUNS runs (default 3, 5 in CI) to smooth the runner variance. SEO 95 applies to indexable pages only. Per-page thresholds went away on 2026-09-10, the session portal (constraint C9 in docs/technical-debt.md) having given 10 points back to watchlist and 7 to my-events: no page needs a floor of its own any more. Runner measurement log, median of 5 passes each time. Before the 2026-09-10 work: home 99, login and profile 97, donate, notifications, legal and privacy 94, forgot-password 93, new and settings 91, my-events and register 88, watchlist 85, event-slug 80. After: login, home and profile 97, forgot-password 96, my-events, watchlist and notifications 95, new, donate, privacy and settings 94, legal 93, register 91, event-slug 82. Four runs were needed, and the back-and-forth taught the most. What they established, by usefulness. **Twelve pages out of fourteen return the same figure to the point from one run to the next, and the two that move are home and profile**, exactly those whose largest element does not come from the React render: home is painted from the document, profile leans on an image. So a 1-point gap on one of the twelve is signal, and an 8-point gap on profile can be noise, which happened, measured three times at 89, 97 then 88. **Never decide on an isolated gap carried by home or profile.** Corollary: anything that fills the first wave of requests pushes these two pages back while moving the other twelve forward, see dead end I9. Three method rules paid dearly: never measure locally to decide a threshold, the development machine returns 67 where the runner returns 96 and two different pages at the same figure signal host contention, not code; locally, read the LCP rather than the score, it matches the runner within about 0.3 s; and a decision made on a single run costs, the one to remove the inline stylesheet cost 1 point on six pages before being reverted. Do not loosen this gate, that is dead end I4: it is the gate that detected that production was no longer deploying, and the one that blocked the web delivery until the C8 regression was fixed.
